CREATIVE PEOPLE. CLEAR THINKING.

Jordan Ellis

Creative Director

I connect ambitious ideas with a clear creative direction, helping brands find their voice and turn it into experiences people remember.

Brand thinking Digital experiences Creative collaboration

01 / A LITTLE BACKGROUND

Curiosity first.
Purpose in every detail.

My work sits where strategy and design meet. I enjoy finding the central idea in a complex brief, asking the questions that bring it into focus, and giving teams a direction they can build on.

At Elvaron, collaboration is part of the craft. From the first conversation to the final review, I work closely with our strategists, designers, and clients to make sure the work feels considered, useful, and true to the people it is for.

Great creative work doesn't just catch your eye. It gives you a reason to care.

Jordan Ellis

02 / WHAT I BRING

A connected perspective.

01?04

Clarity & direction

Turning a broad ambition into a focused brief, a shared purpose, and a practical creative direction.

Brand expression

Bringing personality to life through a consistent visual language, thoughtful messaging, and distinctive details.

Digital thinking

Connecting the brand story with intuitive journeys that help people explore, understand, and take the next step.

Working together

Making room for good questions, constructive feedback, and the different perspectives that move an idea forward.

03 / HOW I WORK

Thoughtful from the start.

  1. 01

    Listen before we create

    Understand your goals, your audience, and the challenge behind the brief. The right questions make a meaningful starting point.

  2. 02

    Find the idea worth building

    Explore possibilities together, connect insights, and agree on a direction that feels both distinctive and relevant.

  3. 03

    Refine with intention

    Make, review, and improve. Keep the details connected to the bigger picture, with clear conversations along the way.
